newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's wine profit starts to flow.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's wine profit starts to flow.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday its wine unit, Mildara Blass, contributed A$33.4 million in earnings before interest and tax (EBIT).
There was no contribution in the previous year as Foster's acquisition of Mildara was complete in February 1996.
Foster's said the Mildara result was achieved on a sales turnover of A$115.5 million.
It said the Rothbury Wines acquisition was completed in July 1996 and the targeted first year earnings growth from the acquisition is on track to be achieved.
"Looking ahead, the 1997 vintage looks very promising and it is anticipated that appropriate grape tonnages will be available to meet planned requirements," Foster's said.
Mildara Blass continues to operate to a strategic plan which has the objective of doubling its EBIT contribution to Foster's over a five year period, the company said.
Foster's, 37 percent owned by the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, earlier reported a two percent rise in net profit to A$169.4 million for the first half.
